summary: Implemented Progress.TimeElapsedColumn and the finished-time capture logic in rich/progress.py, added the progress.elapsed style, added Palette.__rich__ in rich/palette.py, added a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry, added tests/test_palette.py and test_time_elapsed_column, and updated test_columns (column list and hand-traced expected output) in tests/test_progress.py.
